An '''Etherwarp Merger''' is a {{Epic}} item. It is a {{Odds|rng}} drop from the [[Voidgloom Seraph]] {{SlayerTier|IV}}. It is used to combine the {{Item|Etherwarp Conduit}} with an {{Item|Aspect of the End}} or {{Item|Aspect of the Void}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob Drops ===
The '''Etherwarp Merger''' is a {{Odds|pray}} drop from the {{MobSprite|Voidgloom Seraph}}. It has a {{Green|0.42%}} ({{Green|1}}/{{Yellow|236.15}}) chance to drop from {{Stier|4}} {{MobSprite|Voidgloom Seraph}} if the player has unlocked {{Coll|Enderman Slayer 7}}.
